about_the_game:
Experience the relative calmness of the early life in an aquatic environment by listening to this soundtrack collection of music from Thrive. Relax to the sound of calm melodies of floating in the ocean and thinking of future possibilities. But also get your brain fired up for the possibilities of your species with the few included more intense tracks.

This soundtrack includes the complete Thrive Microbe Stage soundtrack as well as uncategorised other tracks used in the game. Note that not all music tracks featured in the game are included here yet as some are part of stages with incomplete, in-progress soundtracks.

As Thrive development progresses, further stage soundtracks will be included. Any purchases of this soundtrack will be updated to include the full Thrive soundtrack once it is finished for the game.
